about: The batch role's answers (config/models.toml, gpt-5.4-nano on Global Batch) to the assertion requests for P130164's ICR and its two ICR Reviews, as lines of a Batch API output file, keyed by custom_id. They are written by hand in the shape the Batch API documents, because the gate's machine has no key. Each answer lists the ratings the report gives in its own fields or sentences, and the ICR's account of the mid-term review in paragraph 78. A live answer may also read item 8.b of the ICR Reviews, which restates what the mid-term review found. One assertion, marked planted, quotes words that are not on its page, so the gate proves the check rejects it. Replace the lines with a recorded answer by running ops/assertions/batch_live.py --record (docs/workspace-catchup.md); it keeps the planted assertion.
